$comment: The overlay client's own tsconfig, mirroring web/tsconfig.json: a browser surface
(DOM, no Node types) inside a repository whose root tsconfig is Node-only. A third
tree, kept separate for the same reason the second one was.
The Vega shell that would host this page imports react and @amazon-devices packages
that cannot be installed here, so no such file exists — see docs/08-fire-tv-overlay/.
